items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript only contains a note mentioning 'Don and Maureen Sickler' in the context of the recording session description. The interviewee (Rudy Van Gelder) does not speak about Don Sickler, nor does the interviewer ask about a personal relationship.

ctx.x: Interviewer: Don and Maureen Sickler with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 44 pp.
Don Sickler: My name is Don Sickler. Today is November 5th, 2011. I am at Rudy Van Gelder’s studio in Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey. Rudy Rudy Van Gelder: Hello.
You were born in New Jersey. Was there music in your house when you were growing up via the radio, or anything?
